messages:
Maya: Heads-upNew prospect (Albatross) sent an RFI. Need a short POC offer, a capability matrix, security answers, and a redacted SLA. Can we pull together by Wed?

Arjun: I'll do the capability matrix. Quick clarifying Q: they want example latency for 2k token context on Dedicated GPUs + hosted; I'll add median/95/99 numbers.

Tess: I'll own the security Qs. Main asks: KMS/HSM support, data deletion, audit logs, SOC2/FedRAMP status, and pen test cadence. Might need Compliance wording.

Noah: Pricing/POC: propose a 10-day POC: 7-day hosted functional + 3-day dedicated perf. POC fee estimate: $9,500 (includes reserved infra). Also include an optional 30-day dedicated trial priced as a separate line.

Maya: good. For pricing table include: hosted pay-as-you-go, dedicated monthly commit example (small/medium/large), on-prem license estimate. Call out that dedicated commit is an estimate pending infra sizing.

Arjun: matrix draft: rows include model family support, streaming, quantization levels (8/4-bit), KV cache sharing, autoscale options, region availability, data residency controls, and cost tiers. I'll mark demo-verified rows.

Tess: security draft note: for HSM we say "integrates with customer-managed HSMs via KMIP and cloud KMS". Compliance asked to avoid implying specific FedRAMP certification. I'll put "compliance programs in scope" language.

compliance-bot: Compliance checklist updated: items pending - HSM attestation text, log retention choices for Private, and encryption in transit protocol specifics. ETA: Tue EOD.

Noah: small ask: procurement wants a sample MSA clause for data residency and termination. Legal team 40Arjun can you flag where to add the appendix note?

Arjun: I'll add an appendix: "Data residency and Private deployment terms subject to signed addendum". Also adding a link to redacted SLA sample.

Maya: Can we include a one-pager appendix with token-level price examples and a chart for cost/unit at different batching levels? Procurement likes visuals.

Noah: I'll prepare a one-pager with examples: e.g., hosted 1.2ms/token median for 512 tokens on gpt-like-6b; Dedicated 0.6ms/token on p4d-equivalent. These are illustrative, include measurement notes.

Tess: FYI, Albatross asked about DLP integrations and whether we store prompt logs by default. We should state: "default logs stored for 30 days; configurable; can be disabled for Private". Legal wants the exact phrasing.

Maya: Great. Tasks: Arjun finalizes matrix by Tue morning, Tess finalizes security text + compliance signoff Tue EOD, Noah finalizes POC pricing and appendix Tue EOD. I'll assemble and send Wed by noon PT.

compliance-bot: File uploaded: `albatross_rfi_matrix_v1.xlsx` -> https://internal.s3/albatross_rfi_matrix_v1.xlsx

Arjun: uploaded matrix v2 with demo-verified checkboxes. Link: https://internal.s3/albatross_matrix_v2.pdf

Tess: uploaded security redlines: https://internal.s3/albatross_security_redlines.pdf. Left TODO on HSM attestation line.

Noah: uploaded POC invoice draft `POC-Invoice-Albatross.docx`.

Maya: thanks team. If Compliance delivers wording early we can include it in the bundle. Otherwise add a comment: "final compliance wording pending at time of submission".

Arjun: will make sure no conflicting statements between matrix and written answers.

Tess: also adding note about shared responsibility for Private deployments and that KMS keys may be customer-managed.

Maya: plan stands. Ping here for any blockers. :raised_hands:
